answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must bind cryptographic attestation chains and zero-knowledge proofs to identity tiers. Minting identities requires a bonding curve where staked collateral scales exponentially ($O(2^n)$) with network size, triggering exponential capital exhaustion for any attacking swarm. Like an uncrossable canyon carved across a frozen tundra, this superlinear cost stems the incoming tide of synthetic adversaries.
